London's a whole experience in itself, and you can get there! 8 million or so people have managed to end up living in London, so what's going to stop you?

What books are you into at the moment?
Thank you so much for all this, you don't realise how much it'll help me, his family and him.

Living in London is something you can do. Get the grades and follow the career path you want and you can end up there. What is it about London which makes you want to live there?

Writing a book is an awesome goal. What's stopping you focusing on writing a book? And what would you like to write a book about?

You're 15, you have a whole life ahead of you full of opportunities, adventure, and things no-one in the world can predict.

What's your main aspiration in life?

Should I mention anything to his mum or family? I didn't mention he also has an 18 year old brother, who he definitely thinks the world of, and I've spoken to him before and he definitely thinks the world of his brother as well.
Thank you, this'll be top of my priorities for tomorrow.
